turns.q: I want the best bang for the buck, not the cheapest or the most expensive.
turns.replyTail:
That makes sense. To recommend the best value rather than simply the lowest or highest price, please send me the names or links of the options you’re comparing, along with your approximate budget.

If they’re mattresses, also tell me your usual sleeping position, whether you sleep alone or with a partner, and whether you prefer a firmer or softer feel. Those details make a real difference to the right choice.
